note: Both sets cover the same 12 facts from the slide (telescope/mirror diameters, focal length, and instrument counts for HabEx, LUVOIR-A/B, Lynx, Origins, and the HabEx starshade), with values, units and conditions correctly bound in each. Set B binds the 10 m focal length to the Lynx mirror assembly and uses fuller quotes, while Set A binds it to Lynx generally and uses ellipses, but neither is wrong. No claim in either set is misread, misbound or invented, and no important fact on the page is left out by one but not the other.
remarks: Both sets omit the 'flying in formation' condition for the HabEx starshade and the fact that the starshade is on a separate spacecraft (Set A at least preserves it in its quote); these are minor configuration details rather than numeric claims. Otherwise the two extractions are effectively equivalent.
